subject: 清西陵 · 泰陵隆恩殿正立面
caption: 清西陵 · 泰陵隆恩殿
五间重檐歇山殿与完整石台基
source_note: 全陵群一条，以泰陵隆恩殿为代表；故宫称1736建成，与1737入葬分别记载。
prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: one architectural heritage illustration for 访古. Image 1 is ONLY the STYLE MASTER, the existing Vairocana contour drawing. Image 2 and any further images are actual monument photographs and ONLY define subject geometry. Match the master's delicate, slightly organic thin black contours, sparse interior strokes, generous white surfaces and restrained visual density. Pure BLACK INK ON PURE WHITE. No black fills, shading, gray wash, hatching, pencil texture, dense brick or tile grids, color, text, labels, watermark or borders. Structural bays, eaves and silhouette must match the real monument. Reduce repetitive detail; do not trace every roof tile or brick. Openings stay white inside fine outlines. Complete apex and full base uncut, generous margins, centered near-frontal, reduced perspective. Remove tourists, trees, vegetation, fences, wires, vehicles, signs and surrounding modern structures. Ground consists of a few thin strokes.  SUBJECT: LONG'EN HALL at TAILING, Western Qing Tombs, Yi County, Hebei. Draw exactly image2's complete early-Qing hall. FIVE structural bays, SIX front columns, two tiers of broad hip-and-gable eaves (DOUBLE-EAVE XIESHAN roof), long ridge with modest dragon ends, deeply projecting lower eaves, timber panel doors in five groups. Single ceremonial hall on a modest broad white-stone balustraded raised terrace with THREE frontal stair routes, central carved ramp and flanking step flights, matching photo. Preserve exact wide low proportion and full end corners. Landscape1536x1024 near-frontal, 82percentwidth, all roof tips and foot of stairs complete. Remove tourists, rubbish bins, signs, metal railings and temporary objects, courtyard perimeter walls, distant trees and all plaque characters. Retain permanent stone balustrade and simplified ceremonial bronze lamps if visible. No three-storey Forbidden City podium, no extra bays, no enormous palace width. Thin pure black contours, openings white, roof planes blank except very few structural ribs.

site_recommendation.yearNote: 全陵群一条，以泰陵隆恩殿为代表；故宫称1736建成，与1737入葬分别记载。
site_recommendation.coordinate_source: Wikimedia Commons Category:Tailing Tomb 公布39°22′09.3942″N,115°20′42.2039″E，作泰陵核心区近似定位：https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/Category:Tailing_Tomb 。
site_recommendation.lede: 泰陵隆恩殿以重檐歇山顶和高石台基构成清西陵最早帝陵的礼仪中心。图版择这一殿代表整片陵区。

facts.label: 断代
facts.text: 泰陵1730年动工、1736年建成；1737年入葬是另一时间节点。

facts.label: 殿制
facts.text: 隆恩殿面阔五间、进深三间，重檐歇山顶，台前御路与两侧踏跺并列。

facts.label: 陵区
facts.text: 清西陵作为一处陵寝群收录，本图仅绘泰陵隆恩殿，不等同全陵布局。

quality_check.notes: 两层屋檐、五间门面、御路和踏跺完整；无文字与阴影填黑。
